label: Community Digest
description: Publish a periodic narrative digest of repository activity as a GitHub Discussion
tips: Use create-discussion instead of create-issue when the output is a periodic narrative or audit rather than an actionable task
Set close-older-discussions: true so scheduled digests don't accumulate as duplicate open discussions
Pick a category that matches the content (e.g. announcements, audits, q-a) so digests are easy to find
Pre-fetch issue, PR, and commit activity in a steps: block before the agent starts writing the narrative
Set mentions: false, allowed-github-references: [], and max-bot-mentions: 0 on safe-outputs so periodic digests don't notify users or create backlinks/bot-trigger side effects every run

When the digest includes trend charts, generate them with Python (matplotlib/seaborn) in a pre-step, publish each with the upload-asset safe output, and embed the returned URLs in the discussion body rather than inlining raw data
